svg.title: FoodShutter system architecture
svg.desc: Native capture, staged analysis, shared meal records and a web companion

g.text: Native capture, staged analysis, shared meal records and a web companion
Cloud credentials stay on the server. The current worker runs in-process; external service setup is required.
